expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
The planned v2 work will expand the protocol beyond the current ping message with a broader set of message types, more robust encoding and decoding, clearer error handling, and compatibility-focused tests so future changes can be introduced safely.

Shipped: v2 Hello is available as `Msg::Hello(String)` with an explicit v2 envelope.
